From: support@coupa.com

Subject: Re: Validation error on W-9 upload for vendor Acme Supplies (tracking ABC123)

Hi Lauren and Jordan —

Thanks for the report. We investigated and confirmed the registration validation is rejecting entries where the EIN field includes dashes or extra whitespace. The parser expects a 9-digit EIN with no separators (e.g., 123456789). Two options for immediate resolution:
1) Vendor re-uploads a corrected W-9 where the EIN is entered in the Coupa field as 9 contiguous digits (they can keep dashes on the PDF itself but the form field must be plain digits).
2) We can create the vendor manually on our side to unblock PO issuance; please confirm you approve manual creation and provide the AP remit email.

If you want us to do manual creation, reply with 'Approve manual create' and confirm contact: ap@acme-supplies.com.

Best,
Coupa Support
support@coupa.com
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick reply and thanks to Coupa Support for the diagnostic.
